t: Saxby CosmosEco V3 Recessed LED Downlights provide reliable and energy-efficient lighting. These fixed, fire-rated downlights are supplied in a convenient 6-pack. Ideal for professional installation in bathrooms, kitchens, and other domestic or commercial interiors requiring robust and water-resistant illumination. The integrated LED technology delivers a cool white 4000K light with 500 lumens, ensuring a bright output for various tasks. Installation is made simple with a 57mm cut-out and a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block, speeding up project completion. With an IP65 rating and a steel body, these downlights offer excellent protection against dust and water jets. The dimmable function allows for adjustable light levels, and the impressive 50,000-hour lifespan reduces maintenance.
